column1: # ZAP's scan rules and the action each takes in this project's DAST (Phase 11 C283.2; Workflow 11F,
# dast-11f). The ids and names are the ones ZAP 2.17.0's pinned image generates (`zap-api-scan.py
# -g`, read from the image on 2026-11-20; `infra/tests/zap.test.sh --docker` compares them), one
# line each: id TAB action TAB (ZAP's name) [TAB reason]. ZAP's packaged scans read this file as
# their config (-c), so the format is theirs. 100000 is the one rule -g does not list (ZAP's
# script-based server-error rule); it alerted on the first API scan and is listed here since.
#   FAIL    an active rule of the injection class ZAP rates High (SQL, code, command, XPath, XML and
#           template injection, cross-site scripting, path traversal, file inclusion, code execution,
#           external entities): an alert of it fails the run at Medium or High risk; its Low
#           "weakness" variants (a payload echoed in a JSON response) are reported with their status.
#   WARN    reported with its status; the run fails on it only at High risk.
#   IGNORE  a false positive or a rule that cannot apply, with the evidence named in the reason;
# Whatever the action, a High alert not IGNOREd fails the run (security/zap/dast-zap.py gate).
